name: draw-your-font
tagline_zh: 拍张手写照片，就能变成可安装的字体文件。不用描字、不用软件，连上次做歪的字母也能一键修平滑。
tagline_en: Snap your handwriting, get a real installable font. No tracing, no software—even fix that wobbly letter from last.
desc_en: Turn a photo of handwriting into a real installable font (TTF/WOFF/WOFF2). Use when the user shares a photo of handwritten letters and wants a font, asks to "make my font", "handwriting font", "turn my handwriting into a font", "font from this photo/image", asks for a handwriting font template, or wants to refine a font made earlier (smoother, thicker, fix a letter). Not for choosing, recommending
why_zh: 同类工具要你逐字描摹，它直接吃照片出 TTF/WOFF，还能二次微调单字，省掉最烦的修轮廓步骤。
why_en: Others make you trace each glyph; this eats a photo and outputs TTF/WOFF, plus lets you tweak single letters—skipping the most.
